name: Warm plate
intro: Something warm, something cold, something sharp, on one plate. Ground lamb makes it dinner; the rest makes it October.
season_anchor: Ground lamb, browned with garlic and chile flakes

variations.context: The default. Yogurt under everything, pomegranate over it.
Sweeter, with something green. The dates warm through in the pan.
No lamb left. Still a whole plate.

finish: Brown the lamb hard in a dry pan — let it sit until it crusts before you break it up — then add a grated garlic clove and a pinch of chile flakes for the last minute. Build the plate in layers: salted yogurt, rice, warm squash and lamb, then everything sharp on top.
